prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1259; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Radiographs demonstrated a distal radius fracture, and the findings on examination and imaging clearly confirm the injury. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash forces and the pattern of fracture seen. No prior injury to the same area is known from the patient's history or records. Initial management consisted of immobilization and analgesia, followed by a course of supervised therapy. Over thirteen visits, the patient's range of motion, grip strength, and pain levels improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as recovery progressed. Billing records reflect a standard sequence of services, with no repeated charges for the same procedures. Treatment is considered to have followed a typical clinical course. Discharge from active care is anticipated once final functional assessment is complete.
